name: week
title: The week
subtitle: Skin Clinic for Claude Code: the book and what wants a decision, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Booked, next 7 days
sections.note: UNCONFIRMED rows are tomorrow's no-shows unless someone calls.
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, substr(starts_at::text, 1, 5) as at, practitioner, client, treatment, case when status = 'booked' then 'UNCONFIRMED' else status end as state from v_appointments where on_date between current_date and current_date + 7 and status in ('booked', 'confirmed') order by on_date, starts_at

sections.title: Open complications
sections.note: The client comes before everything else on this page.
sections.sql: select ref, client, severity, to_char(reported_on, 'DD Mon') as reported, days_open || ' days' as open, description, coalesce(action, 'NONE RECORDED') as action, case when follow_up_booked then 'yes' else 'NO' end as visit_booked from v_complications where status = 'open' order by reported_on

sections.title: Treatment records not finalised
sections.note: Another practitioner must be able to take over care from the record. Oldest first.
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'DD Mon') as treated, days_since || ' days' as age, client, practitioner, treatment, coalesce(record_ref, ref) as ref, upper(record_state) as state from v_records_due order by on_date

sections.title: Reviews and rebooks due, next 14 days or overdue
sections.sql: select to_char(due_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as due, kind, client, treatment as after, contacts, coalesce(phone, email, '') as contact, case when kind = 'review' then 'clinical: call' when marketing_opt_in then 'message' when marketing_opt_in is null then 'call' else 'leave it' end as how from v_followups where due_on <= current_date + 14 and next_appt_on is null order by kind desc, due_on

name: clinical
title: The clinical record
subtitle: Scripts, consents, batches and photos, straight off the records

sections.title: Current scripts
sections.note: Every one after an in-person or video consultation with a prescriber. One client per script.
sections.sql: select ref, client, prescriber, to_char(consult_on, 'DD Mon') as consulted, replace(consult_mode, '_', ' ') as how, product_kind as for, max_quantity || ' ' || unit as up_to, treatments_used || '/' || treatments_allowed as used, to_char(valid_until, 'DD Mon YYYY') as valid_until from v_scripts where current order by valid_until

sections.title: Consents running out or incomplete
sections.sql: select ref, client, consent_group as for, to_char(signed_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as signed, to_char(expires_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as expires, case when financial_consent then 'yes' else 'NO' end as financial, case when copy_given then 'yes' else 'NO' end as copy_given, coalesce(to_char(cooling_off_until, 'DD Mon'), '') as cooling_off_until from v_consents where status = 'active' and expires_on >= current_date and (expires_on <= current_date + 30 or not financial_consent or not copy_given or cooling_off_until >= current_date) order by expires_on

sections.title: Batches, first to expire first
sections.note: An expired batch is never used. Trace any batch to the clients who received it.
sections.sql: select batch_no as batch, product, on_hand || ' ' || unit as on_hand, to_char(expires_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as expires, case when expired then 'EXPIRED' when days_to_expiry <= 45 then days_to_expiry || ' days' else '' end as state from v_batches where on_hand > 0 order by expires_on

sections.title: Photos marked for advertising
sections.sql: select c.name as client, ph.kind, to_char(ph.taken_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as taken, case when c.photo_consent = 'advertising' and c.ad_consent_withdrawn_on is null then 'covered' else 'NO CONSENT: take it down' end as consent from photos ph join clients c on c.id = ph.client_id where ph.advertising order by ph.taken_on

name: money
title: Money and stock
subtitle: Takings, who owes, packages and what to reorder

sections.title: Takings by line, last 30 days
sections.sql: select line, round(sum(takings_cents) / 100.0, 2) as invoiced from v_takings where on_date > current_date - 30 group by line order by 2 desc

sections.title: Who owes the clinic
sections.sql: select client, ref, to_char(issued_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as issued, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as owing, days_overdue from v_invoices where status = 'sent' and balance_cents > 0 order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: Packages with sessions left
sections.note: Packages are for skin treatments only; one on a cosmetic procedure is flagged.
sections.sql: select ref, client, treatment, sessions_left || ' of ' || sessions_total as left, to_char(expires_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as expires, round(unused_value_cents / 100.0, 2) as unused_value, case when cosmetic_procedure then 'NOT ALLOWED' else '' end as flag from v_packages where status = 'active' order by expires_on

sections.title: Stock to reorder
sections.sql: select sku, name, usable || ' ' || unit as usable, reorder_at || ' ' || unit as reorder_at from v_stock where active and low order by kind, sku
